# `set_auto_load_calibration`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Enable or disable automatic loading of the stored guider calibration.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x70f60 (64-bit build) |

Sets the auto-load-calibration option on the guider device object and persists it in the configuration. Unlike set_all_connected, an integer is accepted as a boolean. Downstream validation and event ordering are unresolved. Via the imager command port (4700) the request reaches this handler only as a forwarded unknown method; see the control service for the relay.

Side effects: Changes the operational auto-load-calibration setting and the persisted configuration.

| `params` | boolean\|integer\|array | yes | - | Enable flag: a bare boolean or integer (nonzero is true), or an array whose first element is that value. Any other type gives 106. [READ] |
